question: Show Pembrolizumab combination trials in Renal cell with sample sizes.

gemini.answer: Rows of Pembrolizumab combination therapy trials in Renal Cell Carcinoma (RCC) with sample sizes.
gemini.raw: {"sql":"SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\", \"cancer_type\", \"treatment_regimen\", \"ici_name\", \"combination_type\", \"total_sample_size\"\nFROM public.\"clinical_trials\"\nWHERE \"ici_name\" = 'Pembrolizumab' AND \"cancer_type\" = 'RCC' AND \"therapy_modality\" = 'Combination';","answer":"Rows of Pembrolizumab combination therapy trials in Renal Cell Carcinoma (RCC) with sample sizes.","assumptions":""}
